instructions:
## Objective

Recover reusable latent objects from unlabeled sparse additive mixtures.

## Work to perform

Write fit and transform executables. Infer compact factors without labels or a supplied object count. Output reconstruction, nonnegative strengths, per-object contributions and shared bias; maintain exact additive identity, deterministic inference and row independence.

## Deliverable

fit and transform executables with required four output arrays.

## Evaluation

Hidden factor-recovery, compactness and contribution-isolation metrics across varied geometry and density; reconstruction is diagnostic rather than the rewarded objective.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
